TEACHABLE MACHINE DEMO (5 minutes)
PRE-SETUP: Have teachablemachine.withgoogle.com open in a tab, set up as an Image Project, ready to record. Test your webcam before class.
STEP 1 — Show the class your open hand. SAY: "This is Class A — Open Hand." Record 30-50 samples of open hand for Class A. Do it quickly and dramatically.
STEP 2 — Show your fist. SAY: "This is Class B — Fist." Record 30-50 samples of fist for Class B.
STEP 3 — Click TRAIN. It takes 10-20 seconds. SAY: "Watch the confidence bars. Right now, AI has no idea which is which." Then: "NOW it's training. Watch the numbers."
STEP 4 — Live preview. Show open hand → bar jumps to Class A. Show fist → bar jumps to Class B. Do it a few times dramatically.
CLOSING LINE (say it and PAUSE for 3 full seconds): "That model... was trained... in 30 seconds. You just watched a brain grow. THAT is machine learning."
See-Think-Wonder debrief: - SEE: "We saw a computer learn to identify our gestures in 30 seconds" - THINK: "It needed examples, corrections, repetition — just like the baby" - WONDER: "What if we gave it 1 million examples instead of 50?" (Tease Module 2: "That's exactly what AI companies like Google and OpenAI do")
